all_default.label: You
all_default.text: Use your REPL (Code Mode) tool. In one script: fetch https://example.com with the fetch MCP tool. The MCP server can take up to 90 seconds to connect, so in the script retry searchTools and the call every 5 seconds for up to 120 seconds. Then pass the fetched text to the Bash command "wc -w" on stdin (use a heredoc), and return only the word count number. Do not return or print the page text.
